name: Edil Medeiros
cooked: What a coincidence, last week I did a deep dive week session with the team and we mostly followed ProcessMessage processing paths (handshake, address relay and something on transaction processing). One thing that I put on my todo list was to check if the exception treatment on ProcessMessages was reporting useful/enough information; seems so, but maybe could be improved? I also wonder how many failures on deserialization of message headers (magic, command, length, checksum) we get.
topic_title: Overview of P2P message deserialization failures in Bitcoin Core
